create.block: Hold Ctrl and drag over blocks enclosed by streets; the painted blocks, with their parcels, become a new district. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
create.road: Hold Ctrl and drag over one side of a street (half of the roadway, or the parcels along it); that side of the street, with its parcels, becomes a new district. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.

expand.block: Hover over a district, then hold Ctrl and drag over blocks to add them, with their parcels, to that district. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
expand.road: Hover over a district, then hold Ctrl and drag over one side of a street (half of the roadway, or the parcels along it) to add that side, with its parcels, to that district. Drag to pan, scroll to zoom.
